description: Use this when the user is choosing between 2-4 specific hotels. Returns each hotel's Comfort Score breakdown, price, strengths and complaints, the signals where they differ most, and a verdict: best comfort, cheapest, best value. Hotel ids come from search_hotels (hotel_name finds a hotel the user names). Read-only, no sign-in.

checkin.description: User's check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2027-03-12), if given: links then open on this stay.

name: compare_hotels
title: Compare hotels
